hooks.name: Compliance guard
hooks.description: Checks changed docs/templates against the hackathon compliance rules without editing the file.

action.prompt: Review the file that was just saved for hackathon compliance. Read the "Never say" list in .kiro/steering/hackathon.md and check the changed text against it. Also enforce the badge rule: the phrase "0 bytes to cloud AI" must not appear while the Claude agent is active. Point out every matching line (with line numbers and the offending text) and suggest a compliant rewrite for each. Do not edit the file yourself — only report findings and suggestions. If nothing matches, say the file is compliant.
